entradas.text: “Mr. President, we need to focus on boosting the economy as quickly as possible. One of the fastest ways to achieve this is through infrastructure projects.”
“On the one hand, businessmen are complaining about the slow logistical rail network between Holsord and Lachaven.”

“On the other hand, citizens are criticizing the lack of a proper highway connection between Lachaven and Arvory. The narrow roads by the seaside are not only dangerous but also difficult to traverse.”
“What can we focus on?”
entradas.menu: “What can we focus on?”

entradas.text: “To that point, I defined two important projects for your attention. The H-3 Highway project and the L-1 High-speed railway project.”
“The H-3 highway project.”
entradas.menu: “The H-3 highway project.”

entradas.text: “The H-3 project aims to improve the abysmal state of the road network in the Agnland region bordering Agnolia. The area is home to several million Agno-Sordish and Sordish citizens, who currently feel neglected.”
“Your predecessor Alphonso failed to deliver on this campaign promise. But now, we have the opportunity to start the construction of a groundbreaking railway project.”
“The L-1 high-speed rail project.”
entradas.menu: “The L-1 high-speed rail project.”

entradas.text: “There are no proper highway connections to and from Agnland. The mayor of Arvory, Eric Niel, has been asking for a bigger budget to develop the regional infrastructure.”
"We can't leave the request of Eric Niel -- a party member -- unanswered."
entradas.menu: "We can't leave the request of Eric Niel -- a party member -- unanswered."

entradas.text: “I agree. This could also hurt the local businesses.”
entradas.menu: “I agree. This could also hurt the local businesses.”

entradas.text: “Agreed. The superpowers have led the way with their high-quality technology. We've got to keep up.”
entradas.menu: “Agreed. The superpowers have led the way with their high-quality technology. We've got to keep up.”

entradas.text: “This could also empower businesses and bring investments.”
entradas.menu: “This could also empower businesses and bring investments.”

entradas.text: “As you know, our current trains cannot meet the standards of today. As many other countries adopt new electric engine technology to power up their trains, we're falling behind.”
“That must be cumbersome for the citizens."
entradas.menu: “That must be cumbersome for the citizens."

entradas.text: “The major cities of Sordland need more infrastructure to support their growing populations.”
entradas.menu: “The major cities of Sordland need more infrastructure to support their growing populations.”

entradas.text: “Let's take a more detailed look at the upgrade proposal.”
Lileas was pointing at Lachaven.
entradas.menu: Look at the map.

entradas.text: “I have decided on the H-3 highway project to improve the infrastructure in our poorer regions.”
entradas.menu: “I have decided on the H-3 highway project to improve the infrastructure in our poorer regions.”

entradas.text: “I have decided on the L-1 high-speed rail project to improve the connection between our most productive cities.”
entradas.menu: “I have decided on the L-1 high-speed rail project to improve the connection between our most productive cities.”

entradas.text: “News about the new electric trains in United Contana has piqued our businesses' interest. They too want to transport resources and material from Holsord to Lachaven with great speed and efficiency.”
“He told us that even trucks are having a hard time travelling through the main roads. The increased traffic is causing trouble for people commuting in and out of the region.”
“From there, it will go to Anrica first...”
“Our plan is to upgrade the old L-1 line from Holsord to Lachaven. It will transform into a high-speed railway.”
Gus was pointing at Holsord while Symon was looking attentively.
entradas.menu: Look at the map.

entradas.text: “The Ministry estimates that construction will be completed in two years if every step going forward is executed successfully.”
“Thank you all for your contributions and thoughts. Have a good day.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you all for your contributions and thoughts.”

entradas.text: “Good. Is there anything else?”
entradas.menu: “Good. Is there anything else?”

entradas.text: “The negotiations will begin in the middle of this year. You will be able to award the contract to a corporation of your choice.”
“So, which one do you want to hear about first?”
Mr. Holl repositioned himself on his chair.
“We must prove our capabilities. The people must know that this administration can get things done.”
entradas.menu: “We must prove our capabilities. The people must know that this administration can get things done.”

entradas.text: “We must improve the economy of the nation and bring it out of recession.”
entradas.menu: “We must improve the economy of the nation and bring it out of recession.”

entradas.text: “This should be all, Mr. President.”
“Very interesting. But I still want to hear about the highway project.”
entradas.menu: “Very interesting. But I still want to hear about the highway project.”

entradas.text: “Very interesting. But I still want to hear about the railway project.”
entradas.menu: “Very interesting. But I still want to hear about the railway project.”

entradas.text: “I have settled on a decision.”
entradas.menu: “I have settled on a decision.”

entradas.text: I nodded.
entradas.menu: Nod.

entradas.text: “Thank God. I knew that you would see reason.”
“The right choice, Mr. President.”
“See you soon, Mr. Rayne.”
“Have a nice day, Mr. President.”
“Agreed.”
entradas.menu: “Agreed.”

entradas.text: “What really matters is that your first economic act accomplishes something tangible.”
“The mayor of Anrica, Curtan Leste, also requested this project to be prioritized.”
“We need to pick the most profitable option for economic growth.”
entradas.menu: “We need to pick the most profitable option for economic growth.”

entradas.text: “The citizens and their demands matter the most.”
entradas.menu: “The citizens and their demands matter the most.”

entradas.text: “We need to heed the calls of our businesses in these days of recession.”
entradas.menu: “We need to heed the calls of our businesses in these days of recession.”

entradas.text: “It is not businesspeople who are suffering now, but ordinary folk.”
“Agreed. Improving the rail connection from Holsord to Lachaven would be much more beneficial to our economy.”
“Which is obviously connecting our two most economically powerful cities.”
“Yes, we should link these rural areas in the middle with the major cities of Sordland.”
entradas.menu: “Yes, we should link these rural areas in the middle with the major cities of Sordland.”

entradas.text: “I believe this would benefit Sordish businesses and Sordland as a whole.”
entradas.menu: “I believe this would benefit Sordish businesses and Sordland as a whole.”

entradas.text: “Investing in regions that are already developed makes little sense.”
entradas.menu: “Investing in regions that are already developed makes little sense.”

entradas.text: “We should no longer neglect a key region for our trade with Agnolia.”
entradas.menu: “We should no longer neglect a key region for our trade with Agnolia.”

entradas.text: “Our Agno-Sordish citizens should be respected as Sords like all of us.”
entradas.menu: “Our Agno-Sordish citizens should be respected as Sords like all of us.”

entradas.text: “It makes little sense to put investments in such a remote region.”
entradas.menu: “It makes little sense to put investments in such a remote region.”

entradas.text: “As mayor, I saw the central government continuously neglect our country's Agno-Sordish-dominated regions. Is this administration going to continue that kind of negligence?”
“We are talking about the wealthiest regions and forgetting about Agnland, which needs the investment far more.”
“For the wealthy and middle-class citizens of these regions, but not for the poor dears who wouldn't be able to afford the increased ticket prices.”
“I completely agree. Our attentions must be diverted to the needy. The H-3 is a much more logical plan.”
“Sure. But most goods flow to Lachaven and Holsord, which means we should give more importance to logistics there.”
“Yes, there should be no preference or separation among Sordish citizens. Meaning we should think about what's best for the country overall.”
“That is why we should initiate the L-1 project.”
Evening settled on the beautiful coastline of Lachaven.
“The ministry can only support one project at a time with our current capacity and budget. Let's move on to the details of each.”
Lileas started talking as soon as Symon took a breath.
Evening settled on the beautiful coastline of Lachaven.
Evening settled on the beautiful coastline of Lachaven.
Evening settled on the beautiful coastline of Lachaven.
But enjoying the luxurious mansion wasn't the main reason of our visit. We gathered the economic team here to discuss the new infrastructure investment project.
The view towards the Markian Sea from Lachaven was nothing short of exquisite. The seaside state residence fittingly named the Blue Mansion was large, fine and accommodating.
“Their demands are just. The dire situation of the road infrastructure between Lachaven and Arvory can't be neglected.”
“But the return in investment will be low. Our concern should be economic growth.”
"I'm not fully convinced yet. Please explain further."
entradas.menu: "I'm not fully convinced yet. Please explain further."

entradas.text: “I know him personally and can vouch that he is a trustworthy member of our party.”
“It is, bless their souls. I'm happy we're thinking alike on the matter.”
“I'm not sure if this region should be a priority for us right now.”
entradas.menu: “I'm not sure if this region should be a priority for us right now.”

entradas.text: “Businessmen in the region will be very content, which in turn will increase investments and employment. Therefore I will recommend the L-1 high-speed rail project.”
“Our citizens will be quite pleased if we successfully accomplish this. Besides, if we enter trade talks with Agnolia, they will see the investment as a positive sign.”
“I have to disagree. it will increase the speed of transportation throughout the region.”
“Only technological advancement will give us an edge in the international arena.”
“This should be our priority, growth and development optimization.”
Half an hour had already passed since the start of the meeting. Unfortunately I did not even have the chance to have my usual afternoon coffee.
Looking at the view from the windows, I let my mind drift for a couple of seconds. Symon's voice brought me back into the ongoing discussion.
“Excellent. What will your final choice be, Mr. President?”
“...and then connect to Gelsord.”
“After which it will reach Lachaven, our economic powerhouse.”

“The L-1 will significantly boost the economies of the newly linked cities and even the rural areas in between. Lachaven is our primary port, so the goods unloaded there will be transported to Holsord much faster.”
“...from there it goes all the way to Arvory.”
“As a result, the road network towards the Agnolian capital Staalport will also improve substantially.”
“It has to be pointed out that the highway would be less beneficial in the short term.”
She paused and leaned forward in her chair.
“The H-3 highway route starts here in Lachaven..."
"...and from there it leads to Lenkurg..."
“The planned construction starts right here at the capital."
He leaned forward.
